status: Design proposals only. Syntax checked; these APIs are not implemented or approved.
packageName: manifold is a proposed module specifier, not a claim about registry availability.

a.title: Named objects
a.summary: Create the effect, name its processors, expose controls, connect audio.
a.tradeoff: The most direct reading order and smallest extension of current references. The builder records declarations; it must never own DSP state.
a.identity: The explicit names passed to add and control are persistent keys. Local variable names and declaration order are not identity.
a.discovery: After spectral. the editor offers parameters, inputs and outputs. spectral.parameters. offers the phase vocoder’s actual named parameters.
a.lowering: A control-side builder records semantic declarations, then lowers once to GraphWorkspace plus the existing view/interface records.

b.title: Declarative recipe
b.summary: List named processors and controls in one project description.
b.tradeoff: Easy to inspect and generate as structured data. Callbacks and nested objects make a small patch less linear to read.
b.identity: Processor and control object keys become persistent instance/control keys. Renaming a local callback variable does not rename the declared key.
b.discovery: The processors object determines callback types, including spectral.parameters.pitchSemitones. Control keys are inferred from the returned object.
b.lowering: Read processor keys first, construct typed references, evaluate configuration/control/connection declarations, then use the same lowering path.

c.title: Composable values
c.summary: Create reusable processor and control descriptions, then assemble them.
c.tradeoff: Works well with ordinary functions and composition helpers. The final assembly is more ceremony for a first patch.
c.identity: instantiate/control names identify immutable descriptions within their eventual project or module occurrence. Reusing a definition never shares live state.
c.discovery: instantiate preserves the imported definition’s parameter and port types. References remain discoverable before an owning project is assembled.
c.lowering: Assembly validates membership, uniqueness and connections, then lowers all immutable descriptions through the same graph contract.
